name: Fy2Press Catalog for Shopify
author: Pagup

sections.description:
Your Shopify products, in the WordPress content your visitors already read.

Fy2Press brings your Shopify catalog into WordPress product pages, collections and buying guides. Keep product management and checkout in Shopify, without installing WooCommerce.

What you can do with FREE

  • Publish products, collections and tags as WordPress catalog content.
  • Place catalog components with 17 Gutenberg blocks and 27 public fy2press_* shortcodes.
  • Customize one product design and one collection design with the included Design controls.
  • Help visitors browse with search, filters, sorting and pagination.
  • Display cart components in WordPress and continue to Shopify for payment.
  • Refresh variant availability for displayed components and show Shopify-confirmed cart quantities.
  • Choose catalog indexing settings and a preferred product URL on WordPress or Shopify, with structured product information from the available data.

FREE works without a paid Fy2Press license. You need an existing Shopify store, its subscription and a WordPress site. Full catalog synchronization is manual: run it to refresh saved catalog records. FREE and PRO also check displayed variant availability separately, using a 45-second observation cache. Saved prices and catalog data keep their own refresh paths. SEO controls do not guarantee indexing, rankings or rich results.

Is this the right approach for you?

Use Fy2Press when you want a WordPress catalog alongside articles, guides and business pages. If you only need a purchase button for one product, a simple embedded Shopify option may be enough. Fy2Press does not replace Shopify or migrate your orders into WordPress.

About PRO

PRO is a separate paid edition. Schedule catalog updates hourly, twice daily or daily through WordPress cron with an active license. Build pages with native Elementor and WPBakery components, use multiple templates, and adapt presentation with device-specific settings and custom CSS. WordPress must execute scheduled events; scheduling is not a real-time webhook service. This download contains FREE only.

Compare PRO features and prices or ask a question.

Plan your WordPress and Shopify project

Agencies and developers can use the public Fy2Press reference to plan a catalog, check SEO decisions and adapt reusable client handover templates. Available in English and Canadian French.

  • Choose which URLs should appear in search.
  • Understand how catalog data, prices and caches are refreshed.
  • Build pages with blocks and shortcodes.

This GitHub repository contains documentation. Install the plugin from this WordPress.org page.

Start with one useful page

Install Fy2Press, connect the store using a public Storefront API token, discover the catalog and start manual synchronization. New product pages are published directly: prepare their visibility first. Then check a product and use the included tools to present it in WordPress.

Installation guide | Connect Shopify | Support

Fy2Press support is provided by PAGUP through the support channel. Send product questions and bugs there; use the public repository for documentation corrections. For a confidential security report, include the affected version and a general description without posting exploit instructions or secrets publicly.

Made by Pagup. Fy2Press is independent and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Shopify or WordPress.

External services

After configuration, Fy2Press sends HTTPS catalog/cart requests to the store’s *.myshopify.com Storefront API with its public Storefront API token, product/variant IDs, quantities and storefront context. Shopify handles checkout.

Product images keep the URLs returned by Shopify; visitors’ browsers load them from those locations on catalog pages.

Standard cart buttons collect no buyer email or phone; an integration may supply them to the cart-creation endpoint, and Fy2Press forwards them to Shopify as buyer identity only, never as telemetry or browser storage.

Cookies: fy2press_cart_ encrypts cart references (HttpOnly); script-readable fy2press_has_cart_ holds 1 to skip idle requests, with no ID, secret or authority. Both last seven days (SameSite=Lax, Secure on HTTPS). Shopify stores carts. Legacy shopipress_cart_id localStorage is migrated and removed. Checkout URLs require a checkout request. Prices use the primary Shopify market and returned currency.

Cart and design assets load with rendered Fy2Press content, including blocks and templates. The shopipress_global_cart filter enables site-wide cart access and assets.

Shopify handles this data under its Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. Fy2Press does not send usage telemetry or licensing requests to Pagup.

The Freemius WordPress SDK provides optional usage opt-in and PRO licensing, trials, secure downloads and updates. Opt-in or commercial flows send the site URL, WordPress/PHP/plugin versions, administrator account information and necessary licence/diagnostic data. The FREE functionality remains available when opt-in is skipped. See Freemius Terms and Privacy Policy.

Links to documentation and support at https://fy2press.com are ordinary external navigations initiated by the administrator. Fy2Press does not fetch documentation, fonts, scripts or styles there, or ping links. See privacy and security.

Source code

Source and locked build inputs for every minified asset built from Fy2Press code are included.

  • The Vue administration source is in admin-ui/src; its package manifest and pnpm lockfile are in admin-ui.
  • The Gutenberg editor source is in admin/page-builders/gutenberg/assets/js; its build script is admin/page-builders/gutenberg/assets/build.mjs, with the npm manifest and lockfile at the plugin root.
  • The Composer manifest and lockfile needed to regenerate the committed autoloader are at the plugin root.
  • vendor/freemius holds the Freemius WordPress SDK 2.13.4, third-party GPLv3 code distributed unmodified with its compiled scripts and styles from the official Freemius/wordpress-sdk repository.

In PowerShell: npm ci then npm run build:gutenberg (Gutenberg bundle); pnpm --dir .\admin-ui install --frozen-lockfile --config.auto-install-peers=false then pnpm --dir .\admin-ui run build (FREE administration bundle) and pnpm --dir .\admin-ui run check:bundles. The PRO package adds premium/admin-ui/src and pnpm --dir .\admin-ui run build:pro.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, open Plugins > Add New Plugin, search for Fy2Press, then install and activate Fy2Press Catalog for Shopify by Pagup. Alternatively, upload the ZIP from this page.
  2. Open Fy2Press and enter the store subdomain and public Storefront API token. Do not use an Admin API token or a private Storefront token.
  3. Select Test Connection. Confirm the intended store, then save.
  4. Open Products, discover the catalog and review the result before synchronization. Prepare visibility first: new product pages are published directly.
  5. Open Design to adjust the included presentation. Use Add to my pages or Help for actual block and fy2press_* shortcode examples.
  6. Check a product page, its variants and the Shopify path before sharing the catalog.

Use a staging site when changing an existing catalog. Follow the setup guides for current steps and troubleshooting.
sections.faq:
Is Fy2Press free?

Yes. FREE is available without a paid Fy2Press license, including when optional Freemius usage opt-in is skipped. Shopify and WordPress hosting are separate services.

Do I need WooCommerce or a developer?

WooCommerce is not required. Use the included blocks and Design controls for a basic catalog without writing code. The Shopify connection must still be configured, and theme-specific adjustments may need technical help.

Has Fy2Press been tested with Shopify?

Yes. Fy2Press has been tested with a real Shopify store. The guides explain the configuration and settings to adapt to your WordPress site and catalog.

Is synchronization automatic?

In FREE, you start synchronization manually. PRO adds scheduled synchronization at the intervals described above, off by default; without an active PRO license it returns to manual and the saved schedule is kept. Stored catalog records, component requests and page caches have separate refresh paths. The main catalog and its filters, tag pages, tag filters and search use the synchronized WordPress catalog, including saved price and availability values, as do collection pages without a Storefront token. After editing Shopify data, synchronize the saved records and refresh the relevant page cache when needed. Understand how the data is refreshed.

How do availability and cart updates work?

FREE and PRO check variant availability when components appear, when a variant is selected, after cart operations and when a visible tab returns after its observation expires. Results use a 45-second cache; there is no continuous polling or stock reservation. Out-of-stock sales allowed by Shopify and unknown quantities remain distinct.

Cart additions and updates display Shopify-confirmed quantities and restrictions. A retained line at quantity zero stays readable and removable; checkout is disabled when the cart’s total quantity is zero. If a cart response is lost, Fy2Press reads the cart again without automatically repeating the mutation.

These checks update availability and cart feedback, not saved titles, prices, descriptions, collections or product structured data. Full synchronization and page-cache refresh remain separate.

Can synchronization overwrite my changes?

Shopify remains the source of synchronized fields, and later synchronization can reapply titles and slugs. Existing WordPress post content is preserved by the documented behavior, but check that your template displays it. New product pages are published directly rather than saved automatically as drafts.

What do the SEO controls do?

Choose indexing settings for products, collections and tags and a preferred product URL on WordPress or Shopify. Structured data describes available product information. These are publishing controls, not guarantees of rankings, traffic or rich results. Use the SEO decision matrix to choose the right approach for each page.

Can I use Elementor or WPBakery?

FREE provides WordPress blocks and shortcodes. Native Elementor and WPBakery components belong to the separate paid PRO edition. The builders themselves are separate products. Check your specific theme and layout.

What are the template compatibility limits?

Theme titles (.entry-title, .post-title, .page-title, .wp-block-post-title) and featured images (.post-thumbnail, img.wp-post-image, .wp-block-post-featured-image) are hidden outside .shopipress-template-content; other classes need scoped CSS and mobile tests. Post title, image and date data stay intact.

In block themes, a template for Fy2Press content with Fy2Press blocks or shortcodes, even through a template part other than the header or footer, or blocks through a pattern, renders unchanged; otherwise the Fy2Press view fills its main region. Without one, pages use the theme’s header and footer parts, not the template’s own header or a sidebar.

Shortcodes expand in Shortcode, Paragraph, Heading and Classic blocks, nested ones too, not in dynamic output or data bindings; for lists, quotes, tables or other blocks, use a Shortcode block.

What happens if my PRO license is no longer active?

Scheduled synchronization returns to manual and FREE features remain available. Check the documentation first if your pages use premium templates or builders.

Is there a catalog-size limit?

No universal capacity is guaranteed. Hosting memory and cache limits can constrain large catalogs. Test a representative catalog on staging before a large rollout; incomplete discovery does not replace the last accepted snapshot.

Does the plugin use cookies or external services?

Yes. Cart cookies and the Shopify and Freemius services are described below. Include the relevant information in your privacy notice. Behind a proxy or CDN, list trusted addresses with the shopipress_rate_limit_trusted_proxies filter; only they may supply CF-Connecting-IP or X-Real-IP, never X-Forwarded-For.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

With Delete Settings on Uninstall enabled, settings and caches, not synchronized content, are removed only if an administrator deactivates, then deletes the plugin. The documented WP-CLI command is wp plugin uninstall fy2press --deactivate --user=<administrator>.

Where are the build instructions?

Source code and build tools remain in the plugin download. Developers will find the source locations and build commands in the Source code section of the description.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Check displayed variant availability in FREE and PRO without a full catalog synchronization, using a 45-second observation cache.
  • Show Shopify-confirmed cart quantities and restrictions. Availability checks distinguish permitted out-of-stock sales and unknown quantities.
  • Keep retained zero-quantity lines readable and removable; disable checkout when the cart’s total quantity is zero.
  • Reconcile lost cart responses without automatically repeating mutations, and keep product-form feedback scoped to the current operation.
  • Update vue-i18n and its related translation components.

1.0.0

  • Connect a Shopify store with a public Storefront token and manually synchronize products, collections and tags. Catalog discovery resumes in batches; interrupted writes do not resume automatically.
  • Publish using 17 blocks, 27 public fy2press_* shortcodes, included designs and catalog SEO controls.
  • Present the cart in WordPress with Shopify cart services and checkout; administration available in nine locales.
